It takes direct command of its colony whenever real trouble arrives, leading from the front instead of staying back. Its whole bearing stays composed and dignified, even in the middle of a fight. Little about it looks rushed or unsettled.

media.title: Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, final evolution of the Sinnoh starter Piplup
media.note: Empoleon is the form Piplup reaches at level 36, prized in the games for its Water and Steel typing.

community: Empoleon is often named by fans as one of the strongest-looking final starters, and its regal, commanding Pokédex reputation is usually part of why it gets picked for a team.

why.text: The Emperor Pokémon wields wings precise enough to cut through icebergs, a level of control its Pokédex text spells out plainly.
Empoleon takes direct command of its colony the moment real trouble arrives, leading from the front instead of hanging back.
Empoleon carries a steady, composed dignity into a fight, rarely looking rushed even when its colony is at stake.

name: Luxray

rating_evidence.O: Luxray's eyes are said to see through anything, the sharp perception its Pokédex entries give the Gleam Eyes Pokémon.
rating_evidence.C: Luxray's Pokédex entries focus on family and territory rather than routine or planning, landing it near the middle of the Planning scale.
rating_evidence.E: Luxray keeps mostly to its own pride rather than seeking out company beyond it, the closer-knit habit its Pokédex entries describe.
rating_evidence.A: Luxray watches over its cubs with real devotion, a protective trait several Pokédex entries give the Gleam Eyes Pokémon.
rating_evidence.S: Luxray stays a composed, steady hunter, watching over its family and territory with an even temperament.

personality: Luxray is the Gleam Eyes Pokémon, known for eyes said to see through nearly anything. It keeps close to its own pride instead of seeking company beyond it, and it watches over its cubs with real devotion. Its temperament stays even and composed, whether it is hunting or simply keeping watch over its family.

media.title: Pokémon Diamond and Pearl, Gym Leader Volkner's signature Pokémon
media.note: Volkner, the final Gym Leader of Sinnoh, features a Luxray prominently on his team.

community: Luxray is a long-running fan favorite for its design and for the family-focused Pokédex stories built around it, and fans still ask for a Mega Evolution someday.

why.text: The Gleam Eyes Pokémon watches over its cubs with real devotion, keeping its family close and protected.
Luxray's eyes are said to see through nearly anything, giving it a sharp read on its surroundings.
Luxray keeps an even, composed temperament whether it is hunting or simply keeping watch over its territory.
